turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Mr. Hale? Meredith Kalinowski. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why did my son find out he had a zero from his phone?
"Thanks for coming in." That's not an answer, Hale. Who decided to enter that zero, and did anyone speak to me before they did?
We're not finished. I have a client call at 4:40 and I'm not leaving this room without an answer. Why was the zero entered before anyone called me?
We're not finished, Hale. I'm still waiting on an answer about the zero.
